notes: SDK 1.51.70 upgrades Python/Jupyter import to dkds.python-source-model.v2 with one static Source Workflow graph. Code cells now expose top-level definitions/reads, cross-cell symbol edges, imports, execution roles, DKDS host mappings (DataTable import/export, ScientificPlot, clipboard) and remaining scientific transform families such as pandas.dataframe, numpy.array and scipy.scientific. The analyzer never executes user code. This stage does not pretend Pandas/DataFrame semantics are already portable: workflow candidates fail closed with explicit transform-lowering blockers while portable pure functions continue through the existing Blueprint/Task/package/install path.

SDK 1.51.69 adds one static Python/Jupyter source-import authoring pipeline: .py and .ipynb code cells normalize to dkds.python-source-model.v1; signatures/defaults/types and line/cell-scoped fail-closed compatibility diagnostics precede one dkds.declarative-blueprint.v1; Desktop Plugin Manager previews, builds, validates, exports .dkplugin and installs through the existing production install transaction. User source is never executed and generated plugins require no Python runtime.

SDK 1.51.68 connects the five fixed Resonance declarative Inspector operation-grid buttons to generic domain-bound Surface Actions. Each button derives enablement from authoritative selectedPeak.id and invokes the dependency-scoped live Domain Adapter; the adapter delegates unchanged to the existing production Inspector mutation service for accept/lock toggle, FWHM automatic-window reset, peak deletion and source-sweep selection. No second mutation owner, selection state, Unit, Presenter branch or Resonance-specific generator path is introduced. Dynamic category-palette selection and label editing remain production-owned.

SDK 1.51.67 freezes Resonance Inspector read-only reconstruction parity without adding a new Unit or authoring primitive. The accepted production Inspector and the live Domain Adapter share inspector-detail-projection.js for selected sweep/peak detail rows; the declarative reconstruction consumes inspector.title and inspector.rows through existing public Status/Table live bindings. Category editing, FWHM editing and transform-chart behavior remain with the production Inspector runtime.

SDK 1.51.66 adds bounded live marker-array projection to Unit-owned declarative ScientificPlot bindings. Marker rows come only from the declared Domain Adapter snapshot and map declared id/curve/x/y plus optional color/shape/locked/accepted keys. selectedIdPath feeds the existing public getSelectedMarkerIds() focus contract; selectAction forwards only id/additive plus up to eight declared static scalar arguments. Resonance marker visibility/shape rules were extracted once into main-marker-projection.js and are shared by the legacy production main plot and the Domain Adapter; the generator does not reproduce those rules.

SDK 1.51.65 adds selectedIdPath to bounded live curve-array ScientificPlot bindings. The adapter snapshot supplies the authoritative selected curve id; generated code stores only a transient render projection string and exposes it through the existing public ScientificCurveSurface getSelectedCurveId() focus contract. No local selection bus, selectedSweep/selectedCurve domain owner, plugin-specific focus CSS or Presenter branch is introduced.

SDK 1.51.64 adds one bounded interaction to live curve-array ScientificPlot bindings: optional selectAction. The generated Unit ScientificPlot maps onCurveSelect only to liveDomain.invoke(selectAction,{id:curve.id}); it stores no selection mirror and does not interpret sweep/domain fields. Selection semantics, linked views and inspector behavior remain the production Domain Adapter owner's responsibility.

SDK 1.51.63 adds bounded live curve-array projection for unit-owned declarative ScientificPlot content. A plot may read one array path from the declared Domain Adapter snapshot and map only declared curve/point keys (pointsPath, xKey, yKey, idKey, optional label/colorValue/direction). Generated code owns only a render projection array and requests the existing ScientificPlot Unit to re-render; visibility, filtering, analysis and scientific state remain with the production owner. Runtime-owned/non-curve plots, static-points duplication and explicit linked-interaction policy fail closed.

SDK 1.51.62 adds bounded two-way Domain Adapter bindings to canonical parameter PRIME fields. Number/Text/Select/Checkbox fields may declare statePath + domainAction with one dynamic argument and up to eight static scalar arguments. The same authoritative snapshot refresh pipeline updates public Unit handles; public Unit onChange invokes only the declared adapter action. No generated local state mirror, custom DOM listener, private selector, Unit, Presenter branch or plugin-specific path is introduced.

SDK 1.51.61 adds one-way declarative live snapshot projection onto existing public Unit handles. Bound Status, Metric, Field/Check and Table nodes consume one shared Domain Adapter snapshot refresh pipeline; Table uses setData, Metric uses its public value node, Field/Check use public control/input handles, and Status updates the returned element. Bindings are read-only and require top-level domainAdapter. Summary remains intentionally unbound because its public Unit handle has no update method. No private selectors, second data model, Unit, Presenter branch or plugin-local state owner is introduced.

SDK 1.51.60 adds dependency-scoped Domain Adapter consumption to declarative plugins. A top-level domainAdapter ref/dependency connects through the existing services.domain registry; choice-menu actions may bind to domainAction + statePath, reading the authoritative snapshot and invoking the same owner without a local mirror. Existing commandId/history choice-menu binding remains supported. No Domain Adapter runtime, state store, Unit, Presenter path, or plugin-specific branch is added.

SDK 1.51.59 closes the remaining Resonance-shaped local action gap without adding a Unit or state store. Generic PRIME surfaces can declare bounded choice-menu actions that lower to the existing Workbench ActionGroup and canonical Header action host. Current selection is derived synchronously from Core command history; changes invoke the declared domain command and re-render the existing ActionGroup after completion. No plugin-local mutable preference mirror, menu runtime, plugin-id branch, private CSS, or Presenter change is introduced.

SDK 1.51.58 contract correction: declarative nested/surface ParameterForm layoutOwner now uses the public Unit API vocabulary core|host (default core), matching DKDSUnitParameterFormOptions. The temporary authoring-only unit|presenter aliases introduced during Phase F are removed rather than retained as compatibility syntax.

SDK 1.51.58 extends the generic Surface IR toward the accepted Resonance composition without changing Unit Templates. Non-parameter PRIME surfaces may declare bounded public detailGeometry and command-reference lifecycle adapters; recursive children now include Status, direct Action, FloatingChrome and runtime-owned ScientificPlot Units. A Resonance-shaped specimen proves two generic PRIME surfaces plus physics/spacing/gate SUB views and nested public Unit trees. Lifecycle behavior is expressed only as command IDs routed through the existing Plugin API command service; arbitrary JavaScript callbacks and plugin-specific Unit branches remain forbidden. The dynamic local group-columns menu remains intentionally outside this gate.

SDK 1.51.57 closes the first TER-shaped declarative reconstruction gate without changing Plugin API 1.19.0 or Unit Templates 2.5.38. PlotGroup child declarations now carry bounded public placements/defaultPlacement/detailGeometry and lower directly to existing PlotView ownership; the TER specimen proves the canonical titleless parameter PRIME, nested ParameterForm, seven runtime-owned scientific plots with accepted heatmap/R–V geometry, and two result tables. SDK 1.51.56 added generic non-parameter PRIME/SUB Surface IR with bounded recursive public Unit children, and SDK 1.51.55 added nested ParameterForm inside grouped parameter PRIME controls. No new Unit, Layout recipe, Presenter branch, private CSS path, or plugin-id specialization was introduced.

SDK 1.51.54 adds the third independent production-shaped Phase F reconstruction gate using the accepted Pulse Analysis Unit blueprint as external evidence only. The generic declarative layer now exposes Summary, retained List, EmptyState and portable PlotView composition on top of the existing ScientificPlot/Table/Workspace contracts. Generated hosted scientific workbenches continue to use the standard titleless parameter PRIME and existing TOP lifecycle; no Pulse plugin-id branch, batch state, segmentation logic, private CSS/DOM, alternate Presenter or execution backend is generated. Plugin API remains 1.19.0; Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.53 adds the second independent production-shaped Phase F reconstruction gate using the accepted Pulse Sampler Unit composition as external evidence only. The generic declarative layer can now express bounded Workspace left-rail geometry, content end inset, explicit titleless PRIME priority/embedded/auto-open policy, compact Tabs, separate field-layout recipes, Action Grid, ordinary/segment Toolbar, and parameter-owned Table through existing public Units. Generated code contains no Pulse plugin-id branch, waveform/domain state, private CSS, alternate Presenter or execution backend. Plugin API remains 1.19.0; Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.52 extends Phase F production-shaped reconstruction to grouped control surfaces while preserving one shared Unit/runtime path. A titleless data-control PRIME may declaratively compose multiple headed/plain Panels with Header, Chip, Field, Check, Note and Toolbar Units; page and group actions project from one validated action catalog with icon/order metadata; hosted TOP/Tool pages may opt into the existing workspace close lifecycle while standalone output contains no workspace-only close code. The Transfer Vth blueprint is still acceptance evidence only and production Vth source is unchanged. Plugin API remains 1.19.0; Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.51 adds the first production-shaped Phase F Unit blueprint reconstruction path without changing runtime ownership. Declarative/Python workbenches may select the existing fill-rows PRIMARY recipe, canonical Metric grid, fill-capable ScientificPlot Panel and Core SplitPane/Table result composition; one lowered JavaScript Task may project into Plot, Table and Metric Units together. The production Transfer Vth Unit blueprint is used only as independent reconstruction evidence; generated code contains no plugin-id branch or copied production CSS/runtime. Plugin API remains 1.19.0; Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.50 extends Phase F generation to bounded hosted workspace lifecycles while preserving the existing host architecture. Declarative plugins may remain standalone or opt into the established TOP workbench / Tool Workspace contract; generated hosted packages register through ctx.ui.activities + ctx.ui.pages + ctx.ui.topWorkspace, emit matching manifest workspace/window metadata, derive scientific-renderer window dependency from generated plot content, and project generated parameter PRIME metadata through the existing data-control contract. No private window runtime, Presenter branch, host fork, specialized Unit or alternate lifecycle is added. Plugin API remains 1.19.0; Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.49 closes Phase F generated scientific interaction and replay-safe command authoring without adding a second interaction or execution framework. Declarative plots may opt into stable series identity, reference-only selection, dimension/unit-checked viewport linking and bounded legend visibility linking through the existing ctx.ui.interaction contract. Portable Tasks may expose validated domain commands through the existing command registry with replay metadata and stale-input rejection. Generated plugins still use Plugin API 1.19, Core Task Runner, Artifact Store and Unit ScientificPlot/PlotGroup; Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.48 extends Phase F authoring to multi-source, multi-result scientific workbenches without changing the runtime architecture: declarative content can compose the existing Unit PlotGroup/PlotView/ScientificPlot stack, one lowered JavaScript DKDSTaskDefinition may consume multiple independently scoped bounded DataTable sources, refresh multiple generated plots/tables, and publish multiple declared canonical DataTable outputs with complete source lineage. Existing strict plot projection lifecycle, Core Task Runner, Artifact Store, Presenter ownership and Plugin API 1.19 remain unchanged. Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.47 extends Phase F generated plugins from parameter-only tasks to bounded canonical data pipelines without adding a Python runtime: generated actions discover only plugin-scoped ctx.data.sources, resolve DataTable columns through columnMetadata(), read payloads only through explicit readColumnRange() calls capped by author-declared maxRows <= 65536, execute the lowered JavaScript DKDSTaskDefinition through the existing Core Task Runner, project results through Unit ScientificPlot/Table, and may publish a declared DataTable semantic type through ctx.data.model + ctx.data.artifacts with source lineage and parameter-only provenance. Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.46 adds Phase F portable Python authoring without adding a Python runtime backend: a bounded fail-closed AST lowerer converts proven pure Python functions into ordinary JavaScript DKDSTaskDefinition workers consumed by the existing Core Task Runner. Unsupported imports, free globals, async/stateful constructs and unproven syntax fail generation. Generated plugin packages contain no Python source/bytecode and require no Python runtime. Unit Templates remain frozen at 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.45 freezes the mature Unit ownership boundary: production CSS may retain source-parity domain-internal layout only, while Unit/Presenter outer geometry, managed PlotGroup/PlotView runtime tokens and canonical Unit internals remain single-owner. A production CSS dependency audit rejects unreachable dead styles, Presenter-frame ownership, Unit-internal selector ownership and duplicate managed scientific geometry tokens. Vth's retired stylesheet is physically removed; Resonance/TER duplicate managed-grid/plot-content ownership is retired. Unit Templates remain 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.44 makes Unit Templates the default official authoring path: the built-in developer template plus Workspace/TOP/Tool SDK templates compose Page/Header/Layout/Workspace/PRIMARY through public Units, ship no private layout CSS or hand-written page HTML, and keep the lower-level workspaceSurface facade only as an explicit advanced primitive. Unit Templates remain 2.5.38 with 41 Units / 73 Layout recipes.

SDK 1.51.42 / Unit Templates 2.5.37 unifies Mobile companion outer geometry under one framework contract: Workspace SplitController state is the only right/bottom preference source and resolves its bounded final size from the actual Workspace geometry; shared Mobile CSS only consumes that resolved track token, while Unit intrinsic/block constraints remain internal to their allocated Surface, Presenter performs no companion content measurement/observation, and one Core-owned Mobile split-state schema replaces profile-specific generations. Parameter Drawer intrinsic-width fitting remains a separate overlay contract.

Historical SDK 1.51.41 note: this release attempted content-aware Mobile companion fitting. SDK 1.51.42 retires that outer-track behavior; descendant/root settlement details remain historical context only.

Historical SDK 1.51.41 note: this release changed Drawer/Tabs containment and companion inline constraints. SDK 1.51.42 keeps the Drawer/Tabs containment work but retires Unit-driven scientific companion outer sizing.

SDK 1.51.37 / Unit Templates 2.5.33 closes Mobile companion and parameter-drawer geometry: semantic companion lanes get one Core safe inset and live block-preference negotiation, Mobile parameter Drawer scrolling hides the overall right scrollbar without disabling touch scroll, projected parameter PRIME keeps natural block height so the canonical bottom inset remains visible, and Drawer drag writes are animation-frame coalesced without per-move layout reads.

SDK 1.51.34 / Unit Templates 2.5.30 makes parameter-purpose PRIME outer spacing a single Core-owned contract: desktop and mobile parameter lists receive the same 6 px outer inset, plugins cannot override that outer inset, and non-parameter PRIME detailGeometry.contentInsetPx remains available as a bounded Unit tunable.

SDK 1.51.33 / Unit Templates 2.5.29 centralizes inline/block Unit geometry constraints behind one registry and formalizes the single-writer bounded-configuration policy: plugins only choose accepted Unit tunables, Units own intrinsic/internal layout constraints, Mobile Presenter alone resolves final Surface allocation, and persisted user geometry remains preference-only.

SDK 1.51.32 / Unit Templates 2.5.28 extends single-owner Mobile geometry to the block axis: PlotGroup/GroupArea publishes live min/preferred block constraints from accepted PlotView detail geometry, Mobile Presenter alone resolves the final companion lane against available viewport space, user bottom resizing remains only a preference, and contained PRIMARY workspaces no longer acquire a redundant outer Mobile scroll owner.

SDK 1.51.31 / Unit Templates 2.5.27 establishes single-owner Mobile Surface geometry: Layout/PRIME Units publish intrinsic inline constraints, Presenter allocates the outer frame from those live constraints, PRIME owns the sole outer content inset, and plugins may tune bounded minContentInlinePx/responsiveGeometry without directly writing Drawer width.

SDK 1.51.30 / Unit Templates 2.5.26 retires obsolete Pulse viewport-fill geometry values from the accepted Unit vocabulary and keeps Pulse result composition intrinsic; result PlotView persistence advances so stale dock state cannot remove a result card from its home grid.

SDK 1.51.29 / Unit Templates 2.5.25 guarantees one PRIMARY inline-end breathing-room owner for every Unit Workspace: Unit-owned 12 px by default, or explicit content-owned source parity; generic Core dock slots remain edge-to-edge.

SDK 1.51.28 / Unit Templates 2.5.24 makes Mobile ScientificPlot box capture explicit: touch/pen defaults to scroll handoff and only explicit mobileBoxGesture declarations capture drag-box gestures; Settings overlay stacking and accepted-main mobile action centering remain Core-owned.

SDK 1.51.27 / Unit Templates 2.5.23 makes created SplitPane regions canonical fill hosts and completes Panel sizing=fill shell/body height propagation, so scientific plots fill their allocated pane without plugin height CSS.

SDK 1.51.26 / Unit Templates 2.5.22 adds generic Panel sizing/content-body containment: content-sized Material shells own an explicit body even with header:false, preventing normal-flow children from painting beyond a flex-shrunk surface.

SDK 1.51.25 / Unit Templates 2.5.21 adds Presenter-enforced Unit density floors for parameter drawers, field-height Action geometry, detached-material cold-start deferral, and content-sized scientific Panel containment while preserving the 41-Unit catalog.

SDK 1.51.25 / Unit Templates 2.5.21 preserves the 41-Unit density contract and adds explicit non-wrapping Tabs structure plus source-faithful Workspace/responsive-target composition. Runtime-delegated ScientificPlot ownership is valid only when an existing renderer remains; Pulse Sampler now uses the Unit renderer after legacy presentation removal.

SDK 1.51.21 / Unit Templates 2.5.17 fixes non-greedy responsive composition: width 0 preserves the base recipe, form/action grids collapse only at useful compact thresholds, and Header exposes Core-styled eyebrow/title-emphasis/trailing-meta parameters. Plugin-specific parity remains accepted detail parameters executed by Unit Templates; the catalog remains 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.19 / Unit Templates 2.5.15 makes adoptive Unit identity additive: Layout.apply, host-owned ParameterForm, SplitPane behavior, Workspace/ComponentTree, Portable, Meter/MovableWindow and scientific adoption preserve the structural Unit identity/variant across remounts.

SDK 1.51.19 / Unit Templates 2.5.15 makes adopted Unit roles additive: ParameterForm, Workspace, Portable, ScientificPlot/PlotView, PlotGroup, Meter and MovableWindow no longer erase an existing structural Unit identity. Host-owned ParameterForm can therefore destroy/remount repeatedly without losing its Layout owner. The catalog remains 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.18 / Unit Templates 2.5.14 adds explicit SplitPane layoutOwner:'host' for one mutually exclusive outer-layout owner while Core retains split interaction, persistence and size-token ownership. Together with Layout responsiveTarget and ParameterForm layoutOwner:'host', this closes runtime-inline Unit geometry versus accepted host-CSS ownership without plugin-specific Units; the catalog remains 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.16 / Unit Templates 2.5.12 publishes PlotGroup.getOrientation() through both runtime and Unit facades, so source-parity group controls can commit the correct orientation-specific column preference and call setColumns() for immediate GroupArea reflow. Resonance 3.71.25 also restores Unit-authored text nodes and fixes the global shortcut router typing-target guard; the 41-Unit catalog is unchanged.

SDK 1.51.15 / Unit Templates 2.5.11 closes runtime source-parity ownership for portable Header actions and delegated scientific plot targets. A portable Header with an explicit actionsClassName and integratedActions:false now adopts that authored action host without pre-claiming PortableView controls, so PortableView remains the single placement-control owner. Runtime-delegated ScientificPlot preserves the authored target identity until the canonical renderer attaches. The 41-Unit catalog is unchanged.

SDK 1.51.14 / Unit Templates 2.5.10 adds namespace-aware Layout Unit creation so non-HTML primitives such as SVG are created in the correct DOM namespace. Resonance declares its accepted main plot as SVG through the Unit contract; dynamic Group PlotViews also restore the mandatory title field required by the strict PlotView contract. The 41-Unit catalog is unchanged.

SDK 1.51.13 / Unit Templates 2.5.9 removes the Pulse-specific <=520 px stacking behavior from the generic file-toolbar recipe. Responsive collapse is now an explicit Unit responsiveGeometry detail owned by the consuming composition; Pulse declares its accepted 310 px collapse threshold, preserving 1:1 source geometry without changing the accepted plugin stylesheet. The 41-Unit catalog is unchanged.

SDK 1.51.12 / Unit Templates 2.5.8 adds source-parity Header anatomy (stacked title/subtitle and optional actions host) plus Field control-only composition so accepted native plugin DOM can be reconstructed through Units without raw control geometry. Pulse Analysis is the first production consumer; the Unit catalog remains 41 types.

SDK 1.51.11 moves accepted parameter inset and PlotView content sizing behind explicit Unit detail-geometry contracts. Unit Templates 2.5.7 validates plugin accepted-source geometry at the Unit boundary, rejects raw Workbench/PlotView geometry fields when authoring through Unit Templates, and maps the accepted detail into existing generic Core execution services without adding a 42nd Unit or plugin identity to Core. TER now uses prime.detailGeometry.contentInsetPx and plotView.detailGeometry content sizing for 1:1 reconstruction.

SDK 1.51.10 formalizes source-parity reconstruction: Unit contracts own the shared minimum semantics, ownership, lifecycle and accessibility, while native plugins may explicitly retain accepted detail geometry needed for 1:1 reproduction. TER restores its accepted geometry-only manifest stylesheet, uses source-faithful field/check/header/table anatomy, keeps parameter PRIME titleless by hard contract, preserves persisted workbench/PlotView state keys, and Unit Templates advance to 2.5.6 without adding a 42nd Unit.

SDK 1.51.9 closes real-runtime TER Unit cutover layout/lifecycle regressions exposed after 3.71.8: generic PRIME content is mounted into the canonical body, generated PRIME containers are reused across reopen, responsive plot cards no longer claim cyclic height:100%, and ScientificPlot adds renderOwner:'runtime' so an existing ctx.ui.scientificPlot.react/scalarField path remains the single renderer/observer owner. Unit Templates advance to 2.5.5 while the catalog remains 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.8 fixes the Core page-registration contract for Unit-only production pages: an explicitly provided empty html string now creates a real page shell, while omitted html still requires an existing page. This closes the TER production startup failure “Plugin page not found: terMaxPage” in both main-shell and dedicated-window runtime bundles. Unit Templates remain 2.5.4 / 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.7 completes the first formal production Unit cutover for TER: the production presentation is now Unit-only, legacy plugin.css/shared-views owners are removed, and the existing analysis service/controller/domain adapter/feature runtime remain the single business, numerical and interaction owners. Unit Templates remain 2.5.4 / 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.6 adds TER side-by-side live presentation acceptance on top of the existing dependency-scoped domain seam: the production TER shell and the Unit shell consume the same production state/numeric owner, with bidirectional visible-control sync, full result-table projection, seven production-authoritative plot payloads, and controller selection round-trip acceptance. Unit Templates remain 2.5.4 / 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.4 validates the fourth real Unit-only native-plugin shadow reconstruction (Data Center). Unit Templates 2.5.4 keeps the 41-Unit catalog unchanged, closes the stale Data Center geometry dossier so the chart preview is consistently prime-contained, and demonstrates data-primary/list/table/workflow/dialog/menu composition without adding Data Center-specific Core behavior.

SDK 1.51.2 validates the second real Unit-only native-plugin shadow reconstruction (Pulse Analysis). Unit Templates 2.5.2 keeps the 41-Unit catalog and adds generic nested position ownership through plotView:prime-contained, canonical-header adoption for existing complete PRIME chrome, and SplitPane reflowBelow for Core-owned responsive stacking without plugin media CSS.

SDK 1.51.1 validates the first real Unit-only native-plugin shadow reconstruction (TER) across the seven parity layers and adds the non-surface Note Unit `meta` variant required to reproduce standalone native `.dkds-meta` hints without private classes or CSS; the catalog remains 41 Units.

SDK 1.51.0 formalizes Unit Templates 2.5 as the single reusable UI composition layer: Foundation, Scientific and Composition/Preset units share one runtime path, accepted-scientific-v1 is composed exclusively from the public Unit facade, and no preset owns a parallel renderer.

SDK 1.51.0 publishes a generated 41-unit Core catalog plus authoring-only native-plugin reconstruction blueprints. Every catalog visual unit has a public ctx.ui.unitTemplates runtime factory, TypeScript surface, generated authoring reference and release-gate coverage; native-plugin identities remain outside the Runtime Core.

SDK 1.51.0 Unit Templates 2.5 adds Core-owned semantic state/accessibility contracts and reconstruction dossiers so native plugin state, ARIA, keyboard, presentation, service and geometry behavior can be migrated without copying private UI logic.

SDK 1.51.0 keeps all existing built-in plugin source and authored styles byte-frozen while establishing migration blueprints toward future 1:1 Unit Template reconstruction; no existing plugin is silently migrated in app 3.71.0.

SDK 1.50.0 adds additive Unit Templates over the accepted Core component system. Existing built-in plugin source and authored styles are frozen unchanged; new plugins may freely compose canonical panel/header/toolbar/PRIME/PlotView/PlotGroup/table units without adopting a whole-workbench preset.

SDK 1.50.0 strict units enforce complete PlotView chrome (title/header + position + export), complete-or-absent PlotGroup PRIME headers, Core-owned semantic group spacing (compact 10 / regular 12 / comfortable 14), and the fixed scientific-standard-v1 base interaction policy with non-conflicting domain extensions only.

SDK 1.49.0 visual-template closure in app 3.70.8 makes the accepted pre-1.49 built-in presentation the reference contract: semantic PRIME/ScientificCard/PlotGroup migration must preserve existing DOM chrome, placements, spacing and Theme appearance.

SDK 1.49.0 formalizes Scientific Composition as semantic ownership over existing Workspace/PlotView/GroupArea/PortableView primitives: existing surfaces are adopted rather than restyled, data-control does not imply fixed Desktop placement, contentInset is opt-in, and generated scientific cards reuse the established analysis-chart visual template.
SDK 1.49.0 is current-contract-only: packages declare exactly Plugin API 1.19.0 and the current manifest schema; no legacy composition adapter, alias, shim, or plugin-id exception is provided.
SDK 1.48.0 adds Core-throttled Task Runner progress reporting through context.reportProgress()/handle.onProgress(), with latest-generation and cancellation suppression.

SDK 1.48.0 adds explicit acquisition-order metadata and ctx.data.sources.acquisitionOrder(); shared imports preserve source order metadata and deterministically assign sequenceIndex for missing order within one import batch.
SDK 1.47.0 adds explicit PortableView / PRIME sizing: content (default) or fill (bounded dock remainder). Core owns root geometry and plugins own separate content layout. No new interaction channel.

SDK 1.46.0 formalizes the runtime service releaseActivityWindow(payload) contract for explicit cold teardown of hidden reusable plugin windows. Hiding keeps managed scientific plots warm for fast reopen; releasing closes only hidden child renderers owned by the requesting main window and the next open is a cold start.

SDK 1.45.0 adds explicit ScientificPlot focus visual ownership: focusPolicy.enabled / controllers.focus.enabled can disable Core generic selection paint while preserving the same InteractionRuntime selection, viewport and legend transport. This is intended for domain views such as TER R–V that must render a richer paired-curve and exact-point selection without competing visual owners.

SDK 1.44.0 adds Phase E legend visibility linking as a bounded legend channel on the existing Interaction bridge: explicit legendPolicy opt-in, stable artifactId/seriesId targets, compact isolate/restore state, project-scoped transactions, cycle suppression, and no Selection/viewport mutation or legend-specific global event bus.

SDK 1.43.0 adds Phase E scientific viewport linking as a bounded generic Interaction state channel on the existing single cross-scope bridge: explicit viewportPolicy/axisSemantics, project-scoped transactions, cycle suppression, scientific quantity/unit conversion, per-axis fail-closed compatibility, and no Selection mutation or viewport-specific global event bus.

SDK 1.42.0 adds Phase E heatmap-cell ↔ source-scan reference selection through ScientificPlot scalar fields: Y-aligned sourceScans, lazy cell-to-source resolution, bounded row overlays, and explicit series targeting for source-scan views without per-cell Entity allocation or a second Selection bus.

SDK 1.41.0 adds Phase E table↔curve reference selection through existing TableSurface/ScientificPlot/ScientificCurveSurface and InteractionRuntime: source-row projection, exact point identity, no payload copies, and no second Selection event path.

SDK 1.40.0 adds the Phase E scientific dimension/unit compatibility contract through the single Core Scientific Units owner: semantic dimensions, fail-closed unknown units, explicit SI/compound/affine conversion, Artifact axis metadata, and InteractionRuntime delegation without a second event channel.

SDK 1.39.0 adds Phase E interaction transactions on the existing Selection path: project-scoped link groups, explicit scope/runtime origin metadata, bounded per-runtime transaction deduplication, and remote Selection application that never rebroadcasts the same transaction.

SDK 1.38.0 formalizes Phase E reference-only selection: stable artifactId/seriesId/rowId references, artifactRevision as a snapshot condition rather than identity, bounded source-referenced ranges, and ctx.ui.selection.refs on the existing Entity/Selection/Interaction Runtime path without a second global event bus.

SDK 1.37.0 formalizes validated domain commands through ctx.commands: UI, scripts and MCP share one execution path with bounded history, input Artifact revision/fingerprint capture, exact algorithm/provider identity, parameters, status/output references and opt-in revision-checked replay.

SDK 1.36.0 adds optional createStreamParser() importer sessions. Core owns tokenized 256 KiB file reads, host-specific in-flight bounds, decoding, line framing, cancellation and importer backpressure.

SDK 1.35.0 adds the bounded Core Task Runner through ctx.tasks and manifest-declared task workers. Core owns concurrency, cancellation and latest-generation stale publication protection; plugins must not create private Worker pools.

DataTable columns expose Store-local bufferRevision/columnRevision stamps. Trusted transactColumn writes advance only the changed column; unrestricted full-Artifact writes conservatively invalidate all columns without payload-wide diff scans.
Artifact Store exposes metadata-only Artifact/column enumeration and explicit bounded readColumnRange() snapshots capped at 65536 values; default get/list remains unchanged.

Artifact Store exposes Store-owned immutable Column Buffer snapshots and synchronous fixed-length transactions with dtype, ownership, optimistic revision and rollback validation; default get/list remains unchanged.
Artifact Store exposes typed artifactRevision(id), revision(kind) and fingerprint(id) identities for Store-local, aggregate and persistence-stable invalidation respectively.
SplitController preserves preferred size/ratio, placement and collapse intent separately from the viewport-clamped effective size; Desktop and Native Mobile use one pure resolver.
Workspace regions declare an explicit scroll policy, and layoutDiagnostics performs bounded read-only inspection instead of automatic full-subtree recovery.
Numeric Artifact factory inputs accept arrays or TypedArrays, copy them into the current serializable representation, and reject malformed matrix shapes.
Performance callbacks execute at most once per facade call; fulfilled Promise caches store resolved values and rejected Promise caches are evicted for retry.
Historical project files are the only compatibility boundary. They are normalized by the Project Compatibility Gateway before current runtime/plugin code sees project state.
GroupArea is the canonical related-multi-plot container through ctx.ui.groupArea.create(...) / PluginWorkspace.groupArea(...); managed Grid has no alternate GroupArea flag.

Managed Grid orientation behavior is explicit through orientationPolicy and optional preferredColumns(...). The policy is domain-neutral and opt-in; plugins do not own final grid-template-columns geometry.
PluginWorkspace PRIMARY/PRIME/SUB plus TOP presentationRole are the current workspace composition contract. There is no second low-level workspace composition facade.
Theme packages target Theme Contract 3.10.0 exactly and validate directly against the current Theme schema.
Plugin dependencies declare current package ids only.
The SDK is standalone and does not require DK Data Studio source code.

portableSizing.fill: Consumes remaining dock height, ignores saved intrinsic card height. Content must use a separate inner layout node. Floating and mobile projection retain their platform sizing.

features: SDK 1.51.36 / Unit Templates 2.5.32 extends the single-owner Mobile geometry contract to active scientific companions: non-parameter PRIME may publish bounded minContentBlockPx, GroupArea publishes its accepted minItemWidth as a one-item inline constraint, Presenter reserves real companion safe area before allocating the parameter Drawer, and the Drawer scroll host keeps overlay scrollbar chrome outside the uniform parameter content inset.
releaseNotes: SDK 1.51.43 / Unit Templates 2.5.38 adds retained dynamic List handles: units.list.create() owns the concrete list instance across Presenter reparenting, exposes atomic setItems()/items(), and Core-owned leading/title/meta ListItem anatomy. Plugins provide item descriptors rather than rediscovering reparented list DOM or rebuilding canonical row anatomy.
